transformer.name: weaviate:embeddings
transformer.title: Weaviate (Embeddings)
transformer.description: Prepares the message to become an object writable by Weaviate component

transformerIn.description: A LangChain4j TextSegment, or a String the converter of camel-langchain4j-embeddings turns into one, whose text goes in the CamelWeaviateProperties header for CREATE and UPDATE_BY_ID; another body stores no text. The embedding comes from the CamelLangChain4jEmbeddingsVector header, which must be set, and the CamelWeaviateAction header must be CREATE, UPDATE_BY_ID or QUERY
